items.text: Explained its vote against the second enforcement budget law as opposition to unneeded spending, saying it supports the officers who enforce immigration law and that the agencies still held most of their earlier funds.

Said immigration authorities have the right and responsibility to enforce immigration law and called a targeted operation against people engaged in crime in the legislator's home region in the public interest, while asking that enforcement put public safety first, spare people with legal status, obey court orders, and follow due process.
